notes.title: Upcoming update – new screenshots
notes.notes: [h3]Hi![/h3][p]The new big update is already at a pretty advanced stage, so I thought I’d share a few screenshots showing some of the new locations and some of the fresh features coming to the game.[/p][p]Originally, I wanted to release the update during mushroom season, but it turned out there’s more work left than I expected. Right now, autumn seems like a more realistic release window, though that could still change.[/p][p][b]Thanks a lot for your patience and support![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101270/a2270178bd0417edebb55273ea4c3a198b5e57d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101270/6fdfe79d5feaede72f38a45f7d2dabece1382dec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101270/d339e1da9780f641c2587448aea8c5fc5056e8b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101270/2e898027696ecc2191d37f93710efdfc904d40f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101270/f727f7bd5d579e5bdd7fab4489108228ce6ef13b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101270/18e4ed1c0d6102d12696f833d7c72e582b308f6f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.1.7
notes.notes:
Hotfix fixes an issue where the player couldn't eat and drink

I am sorry for the issues and thank you very much for reporting the issue!

notes.title: Small Update 4
notes.notes:
A small update with a few fixes and minor changes

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Added the ability to move the map
- Map should be easier to read
- Slightly changed smartphone interface
- Sound settings now affect all sounds
- Added a brightness adjustment slider
- Improved gamepad performance at lower FPS
- You can now ask Grandpa about any mushroom in your inventory
- Minor tutorial adjustments
- Fixed a bug that allowed mushroom duplication
- Added a warning on the game's start screen
- Fixed the issue with teleporting NPCs. For good this time
- Added turn signal dashboard lights
- Many other small fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.1.5
notes.notes:
- The mushroom machine should no longer swallow baskets
- Fixed an issue where mushrooms picked in the undergrowth appeared too close to the camera
- Fixed an issue with disappearing characters
- Fixed the mechanics of filling bottles
- Several smaller fixes/changes
- New Steam achievement

notes.title: Small update 3
notes.notes:
A small update containing a lot of fixes and a few minor changes

[b]Changelog:[/b]
- Working gauges in cars
- Changed interior appearance of the gas station
- Added optional autosave
- Added trash bins for discarding unwanted items
- Added license plates to cars
- Added the ability to reset control settings
- Mushrooms will no longer clip through the basket
- Slight change to the baskets' capacity
- Restored vehicle control with the WSAD keys
- Flashlight beam is now more evenly distributed
- Fixed incorrect collisions in hotel rooms
- The pickup truck now has slightly more power in first gear
- Fixed incorrect description of the muscle car
- Painting the car automatically cleans it
- Hay and packages should no longer fly into the air when touching the pickup’s wheels
- Minor changes to mushroom growth mechanics
- Optimized the mushroom spawning system
- Fixed a bug where mushrooms picked directly into the basket from the ground would disappear after a while
- Fixed several spots where the player character could get stuck
- Minor fixes for gamepad controls
- Restored the ability to pick mushrooms from under branches
- Collision system improvements for character-vehicle interactions
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Hotfix 0.9.1.3
notes.notes:
Fixes list:
- Fixed an issue with hotel charges  
- Fixed a blocking dialogue bug with the priest  
- Fixed a bug that caused the priest's car to duplicate during purchase  
- Adjustments in control options  
- Fixed a bug that could potentially trap the player character in the hotel room when saving and loading the game there  
- Fixed a bug that could potentially cause baskets to get stuck in the machine

notes.title: Mushroom Season - Update 1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Update 1[/b][/h1]

Hi there!

The update took a bit longer than I planned – sorry for the delay. The game now has a lot of new content, and I hope you’ll enjoy it! I don’t want to spoil everything in the changelog to keep some surprises. Let me know what you think!

[url=https://i.ibb.co/stGGCd5/screenshot1.png][img]https://i.ibb.co/qxffC30/screenshot1.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New locations
[*] New vehicle
[*] New side quests
[*] New Steam achievements
[*] Basic controller support
[*] 5 new mushroom species
[*] New items (food, basket, etc.)
[*] Improvements to existing locations
[*] Option to switch to manual transmission
[*] Added keybinding customization
[*] Minor changes to Grandpa Marian’s house furniture
[*] Ability to switch between carried baskets
[*] Unfortunately [b]saves from the previous game version are not compatible with the current one[/b]. However, I’ve reworked the save structure to prevent this issue in future updates.
[*] The player character is now visible behind the wheel while driving
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Alternative option to choose dialogue (arrows)
[*] Fixed an issue with a car disappearing when the player went to sleep
[*] Fixed freezing dialogues
[*] Improved vehicle controls
[*] Adjustments to mushroom growth cycles
[*] Changes to game economy
[*] It is no longer possible to drop a basket by pressing "G" on an occupied slot, which often caused baskets to get lost
[*] Small mushrooms and items should no longer fall "under the map"
[*] Fixed a bug where the mechanic didn’t charge for repairing a specific car
[*] Improved fog rendering distance
[*] Chanterelle texture changed to a slightly more yellow hue
[*] Grass no longer clips into vehicle interiors
[*] Added a slider to adjust mushroom rendering distance
[*] Vehicle interior camera movement is now smoother
[*] Fixed tire screech sound occurring at high speeds
[*] The game should now run smoother
[*] Loading times have been slightly improved
[*] Improved wet surface effect after rain
[*] Cars should no longer fly into the air when running into them
[*] NPCs driving cars should no longer clip through the windshield
[*] "Mushroom-o-matic" should no longer swallow large buckets
[*] Fixed several minor translation errors
[*] Many other minor changes
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update 2
notes.notes:
Small update that fixes some issues

- Fixed issue where mechanic took way too much money for painting the car
- Fixed issue where money could go to negative values after painting the car
- Fixed issue where it was possible to put crates in the inventory using 1-9 buttons
- Fixed issue where thirst decay was too slow
- Fixed issue with AI drivers being located incorrectly in the car
- Music volume setting affects all in-game copyrighted music now
- Improved mirror performance
- Basket in active slot will no longer be visible after getting in the car
- Minor visual changes

notes.title: Small Update 1
notes.notes:
- Added UI icon that shows when it is possible to get in to the car
- Minor textures changes
- Game window can now be resized in "Windowed" mode
